# #58997 [Core] Remove deprecated mamba_cache_mode "all"

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58997 · ZJY0516 · MERGED · created 2026-09-28T08:49:52Z · merged 2026-10-01T09:59:38Z

**plan to merge this after v0.31 branch cut**

## Purpose

Remove `mamba_cache_mode="all"`, deprecated in #55041 (v0.30.0). It is unsupported in MRV2 and never auto-selected (prefix caching defaults to `"align"`). `--mamba-cache-mode all` now fails validation.

This drops the `"all"`-only paths in config/platform, per-model guards, Mamba metadata builders, `MambaMixer`/`MambaMixer2`, the GPU model runner, `MambaSpec` sizing, and the NIXL/MoRIIO positional SSM transfer. `"none"` and `"align"` are unchanged.

Follow-ups (out of scope): the now-unused optional `block_idx_*` kernel args, and the `supports_mamba_prefix_caching` flag.

No existing PR removes this mode. Open PRs building on `"all"` (#54637, #50172, #55260, #54612, #46048) would no longer apply.

## Test Plan

- `pre-commit`, mypy
- Unit tests for the touched config, KV cache manager, scheduler, Mamba metadata, worker, and connector suites
- `tests/models/language/generation/test_hybrid.py -k apc`
- gsm8k with prefix caching, main vs this branch

`"all"`-only tests are removed; the two hybrid scheduler tests are ported to `"align"` with unchanged expectations; the NIXL Mamba prefix-cache script now uses `align`.

## Test Result

- pre-commit, mypy: pass
- Unit tests for the touched suites: 2365 passed. The only failures are 2 `test_cpu_offloading` Llama-3.2-1B (FLASH_ATTN / FLASHINFER) cases on a CPU-vs-cold timing assertion, which fail identically on the base commit.
- `test_hybrid.py -k apc` (Jamba, falcon-mamba): 7 passed

gsm8k, 5-shot, `--limit 250`, `enable_prefix_caching=True` (align), GB200:

| Model                        | main (strict / flexible) | this PR (strict / flexible) |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| granite-4.0-h-small (Mamba2) | 0.868 / 0.868            | 0.852 / 0.852               |
| Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8 (GDN)    | 0.744 / 0.760            | 0.808 / 0.824               |

Differences are within run-to-run noise (stderr ~0.02-0.03).

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used; I have reviewed the changes and run the tests above.
